In [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] convened to '''elect''' a new [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] to lead the democratic government. [[Vaner Shan]], the son of famed Jedi [[Bastila Shan]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], ran for this election, with his upbringing during the chaotic aftermath of the Great Sith Wars playing a key role in his running for Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Timeline" />
